'''Jarvey''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal living during the [[Galactic War]]. He was imprisoned on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], where due to his comparatively low threat he was kept in the [[Minimum Security Section]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jarvey is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Smuggler class mission on Belsavis.
